title: CBT Cards public resources
description: New and updated CBT Cards learning guides, worksheets, toolkit resources, and agent-facing public data.

items.title: Free CBT reflection worksheets
items.content_text: Browser-local printable worksheets for a CBT thought record, worry time, and activity planning, with no account or submit action.

items.title: CBT thought record worksheet
items.content_text: A seven-step printable browser worksheet for structured thought-record reflection.

items.title: Worry time worksheet
items.content_text: A browser-local worksheet for recording a worry, parking it, and returning to it during a planned review period.

items.title: Activity planning worksheet
items.content_text: A printable activity-planning worksheet for making one next step concrete and reviewing the result.

items.title: CBT Cards learning library
items.content_text: Plain-language, sourced guides to thought records, automatic thoughts, thought-vs-fact reflection, worry time, activity planning, and structured journaling.

items.title: CBT Cards public toolkit
items.content_text: A public entry point to curated reflection cards and provenance for the related CBT Toolkit source corpus.

items.title: CBT Cards for AI agents
items.content_text: Canonical web, JSON, JSONL, worksheet-schema, llms.txt, and versioned skill interfaces for public CBT Cards resources.
